decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot is a flagship of the firm's automation strategy, and its long sales cycles justify keeping it.
The de-shuttering robot is a modular component of integrated circulation lines and adds value at low marginal cost, though it could be folded into the combined robot over time.
The profile storage robot supports automated shuttering workflows and standardization within the firm's integrated plant solutions.
Automatic shuttering robots are central to future-ready automated precast production and to growing housing construction needs.
This newly launched product line with several models fits the firm's integrated automation offer and needs time to gain market traction.
The production analysis software strengthens lifecycle support and digital offerings at low ongoing cost and complements the machinery portfolio.
